name: Custom Shape Mini Wooden Bookshelf Decor
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, featuring 3mm thickness for all panels and components.
    - Smoothly cut and polished surfaces provide a sturdy yet lightweight structure.
    - Includes wooden number cubes and custom decorative pieces, all precisely cut for a clean fit.
    -  Wood finish adds a warm, minimalist look suitable for any space.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall bookshelf size: 4 x 4 inches ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm.
    - Number cubes: 1 x 1 x 1 inch ~ 2.54 x 2.54 x 2.54 cm, 3 cubes included.
    - Custom decorative pieces: up to 8 pieces (design-dependent).
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using high-quality printing technology for clear, sharp, and long-lasting colors.
    - Features double-sided printing on wooden panels, number cubes, and custom pieces.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a mini wooden bookshelf with a book-counting function.
    - Includes 3 rotating number cubes to track the number of books read.
    - Perfect for book lovers, readers, students, teachers, libraries, classrooms, or reading corners.
    - Functions as both a reading tracker and a decorative mini bookshelf.

 

  • Easy Assembly:
    - Requires simple self-assembly by interlocking the pre-cut wooden pieces.
    - All parts fit together easily by hand — no tools or glue needed.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful and practical gift for readers, book lovers, students, teachers, and book club members.
    - Ideal for birthdays, holidays, back-to-school, Teacher’s Day, or reading challenges.
    - A unique keepsake that encourages reading habits while adding charm to any space. 📚

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xCustom Shape Mini Wooden Bookshelf Decor

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
